column5: Thermal-conductivity requires mean-test-temperature-as-local-model=1, explicitly accepting the measured apparent through-thickness conductivity across a finite 20 K gradient as a local scalar coefficient at the same numerical temperature. This engineering interpretation is not deconvolution, a new point measurement or in-plane equivalence. Apparent-thermal-conductivity keeps the native test-mean-temperature coordinate.
